name: collision-guard
description: Warns when two Claude Code sessions on this machine edit the same file, and holds a git command once when it would stage, commit, stash or discard another session's uncommitted edits.

git.title: Git commands
git.description: confirm: hold a git command that would touch another session's uncommitted edits once, and let it run when the agent runs it again within 2 minutes. note: let it run and tell the agent afterwards. off: leave git commands alone

windowMinutes.title: Window outside git (minutes)
windowMinutes.description: How long another session's edit to a file outside any git repo still counts. Inside a repo, an edit counts while git shows the file as changed

expireHours.title: Session expiry (hours)
expireHours.description: A session silent for this long counts as gone, and its record is removed
